title: Girls Versus Suits
cn: 第 12 集 · 女孩对阵西装
novel:
Ted met a woman named Jen who hated men in suits. Barney, who lived in suits, was [[offended|offend]]. "Suits are [[sacred|sacred]]," he said. "They are the armor of [[civilization|civilization]]."

A war began. Barney [[recruited|recruit]] the whole bar into a [[musical|musical]] number about suits. Ted tried to hide his own [[secret|secret]] love of fine jackets.

Meanwhile, Ted pursued Jen, hoping his [[casual|casual]] style would win her. But she saw through him. "You're just like your friend," she said. "You love suits too."

Ted [[confessed|confess]]. She was right.

In the end, the musical erupted — a [[legendary|legendary]] [[chorus|chorus]] of dancers in sharp suits, twirling under golden lights. Even Jen had to admit it was [[magnificent|magnificent]].

Barney smiled, [[triumphant|triumphant]]. "Suits," he declared, "always win." Ted laughed and put on his jacket. Some [[battles|battle]], he realized, were worth losing — especially when the other side looked that good.

offend.en: to make someone feel upset or angry

sacred.en: very important and treated with respect

recruit.en: to find people to join a group

musical.en: a play with singing and dancing

confess.en: to admit something you tried to hide

legendary.en: famous and talked about for a long time

chorus.en: a group of singers or dancers acting together
